note: Issue #237: the square port, kept as a town layout (planets pick one by town_layout; the place it is stays port_town). IP-neutral greybox layout. +X is the gate side (toward the desert and outpost). Boxes are axis-aligned min/max corners. Edit numbers here, never in code.

boxes.note: The round landing pit: a round wall from the pit floor up to the street, with the street filled in round it, open where the ramps run out. Hollow: other boxes sit inside it. Built by src/systems/world/pit_bowl.gd.
Bay 1: the player's ship (the town_pit launch pad).
Bay 3: an empty landing pad (issue #58), a round plate inside the bay's painted ring. The ship you buy from T-89 is parked here; it stays empty until you do. No collision: you walk across it.
The stage in the middle of the cantina. Nobody plays.
Round tower behind the bar: a helical ramp (rise m per turn) around a core, door on the bar side. Built by src/systems/world/stair_tower.gd.
The lookout room on top of the stair tower, open on all sides over the town.
Market stalls: two rows facing each other across the aisle (z -42..-34). Each is a waist-high counter on the aisle side and a back panel; the merchant stands between them.

Issue #76: the Remnant's landing pad in the barracks yard. Its dark interceptor (remnant_ship) stands here and hunts you in the air when you are wanted (src/systems/flight/atmo_fighter.gd); shot down, a new one is here a while later. No collision: the ship carries its own hull.
Gate checkpoint barricade: waist-high cover for the gate guards, off the gate lane.

markers.note: Issue #82: the Remnant's black and red Sand-boxer, parked outside the front gate off the gate lane, nose to the desert. Not rideable; gone with the town garrison.
A local on a bar stool, facing the cantina owner.
A local on a bar stool, facing the cantina owner.
A local on a bar stool, facing the cantina owner.
West roof rifleman: over the yard's west half and the crates.
Centre roof rifleman: down the middle of the yard to the main street.
East roof rifleman, in front of the upper block: the yard's east side and the gate.
T-89, the ship salesman (issue #58): near the spawn, facing it, and further than a ship's board reach from every bay so E talks to him, not the ship.

Issue #64: behind the barracks hall, between it and the north wall. A Remnant trooper killed in town comes back here a minute later (while the garrison still holds the town) and walks back to its post.

routes.note: North gate guard's loop, clear of the gate lane (|z| > 6).
South gate guard's loop, clear of the gate lane.
West barracks trooper's loop round the yard crates.
East barracks trooper's loop between the hall and the yard wall.
Round the end of the bar, in at the tower door and up the spiral ramp to the lookout. Helix points match stair_tower.gd ramp_walk().
A local's walk round the west houses: along the crooked lanes of the new houses and back by the street (art pass 2).
A second west local: along the crooked lanes of the new houses and back by the street (art pass 2).
The east houses' local, mirroring stroll_resident_w.: along the crooked lanes of the new houses and back by the street (art pass 2).
A shopper: down the aisle (north half), back behind the north stalls.
A shopper: the back lane by the shops, then up the aisle (south half) the other way.

garrison.note: The town's Remnant garrison (M15): one alarm for every trooper here. Klaxon at the watchtower. disengage_dist is from the nearest trooper, who will not chase past its chase_leash (gate 30 m, barracks 55 m), so running out into the desert does lose them.

locals.note: The port's own people. They mind their business until you hurt one; then every local in town fights you (merchants and the fence from behind their counters, never leaving the stall). Same alarm rules as the garrison, its own alarm: shooting a local does not call the Remnant, and the other way round.
